scenario: [LNUL.8.4] with [LNUL.4.1]: a path read whose root is `null`, a `Json?` slot holding none, has no document to resolve against, so it yields `null` and raises no fault, and the `null` propagates through a comparison. One `Doc` is asserted with `body` null. `absent` reads `d.body.c is null` and fires. `hot` reads `d.body.c > 30.0`, whose `null` operand propagates, so it does not fire. `handler` matches any `TypeError` fault fact ([LERR.9.3]) and must not fire. A runtime that raises a type mismatch on the `null` root fires `handler` and not `absent`. PATH PINNED: the compiler lowers `d.body.c` to `FN_JSON_PATH` over the slot (`dsc.rete`), whose handler meets a `null` root: libds `builtin_json_path` (builtins.c), Mercury `ds.eval`'s `fn_json_path` arm through `json_walk`.
rules_ds:
schema Doc scope ttl 10_s:
    body: Json?

rule hot:
    Doc d where d.body.c > 30.0
->
    log info "hot"

rule absent:
    Doc d where d.body.c is null
->
    log info "absent"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log critical "type error"
